name: Enterprise Offering Portfolio Scope and Landscape

basisRoles.WM-ECO-020: order and delivered or outstanding accounting

constraints: Neither Offering Portfolio Scope nor Offering Landscape is a source of commercial commitment or entitlement.

Product, Service, Offering, Quote and Entitlement remain distinct subjects, each on its own allocated master or, where unallocated, on its owning candidate master; none is a subtype of scope or landscape.
Membership derives from versioned market, channel, availability and policy predicates and a declared as-of time.
Offering Landscape reads source masters and writes none.
Offering Landscape cannot authorise or evidence a quote, order, subscription, entitlement grant or retirement; it may only project state its source masters already hold.

Portfolio decisions and external citations reference catalogue state plus a frozen scope version; the landscape is never the cited source of authority, and an obligation that depends on an admitted set cites the frozen scope version and catalogue baseline.
Inclusion, exclusion, override and exception are explicit recorded predicate outcomes per evaluated candidate; a silent gap is never an exclusion.
Comparison basis, criterion set, units, observation windows, sources and class-specific adjustments are explicit and justified; co-membership is never comparability.

A comparability verdict is exactly one of comparable, partial or incomparable; partial requires a declared justified outcome class with class-specific criteria restated for that class and the adjustment stated; silence is not comparability; co-membership in a scope is never comparability.

Zero revenue never means zero value and missing price never means free; every in-scope internal service carries at least one typed non-revenue value term with method and uncertainty; zero external revenue is never scored as zero value in any landscape ranking or ordering; cost-to-serve may be recorded but never substitutes for the typed value.

A duplicate-outcome claim records status suspected, substantiated or refuted with method, evidence references, retained contradicting evidence and confidence; substantiation requires all four of semantic-equivalence, consumer-overlap, entitlement-overlap and substitution evidence, and missing any one caps the status at suspected; name similarity may open a review and is never evidence.
Offering retirement never cancels quotes, order lines, subscriptions, contracts, obligations or entitlements; each closes on its own master by its own authorized outcome.

Every offering retirement record states dated retirement states, support window, retention window, migration path and entitlement conversion, and either a successor reference or an explicit no-successor reason; a blank successor is invalid.

Every released view pins scope version, scenario, horizon, source as-of and computation time, keeps source as-of distinct from computation time, and remains resolvable after supersession; a changed predicate, market scope or portfolio policy creates a successor scope version and never a rewrite in place; superseded scope and view versions remain addressable.

A scope version is evaluable only against an allocated, versioned Offering Catalogue baseline; while the catalogue candidates are unallocated, scope evaluation and landscape release are inadmissible and no evaluation result may be cited.
holds: Product Catalogue, Offering Catalogue and Consumption Entitlement remain identifier-unassigned in their owning contours.
WM-ACT-004 publication semantics and relationship contracts require reconciliation.
The obligation mixin is carried as WM-XCT-029; the WM-ACT-029 spelling in prior prose is treated as a transcription variant and is not asserted as a separate base.
WM-SFT-001 and WM-MAT-008 adjacency is unevidenced in the frozen dossier and must be re-evidenced before reinstatement as a base.

Offering Catalogue and Product Catalogue are unallocated, so the profile has no target master and no scope evaluation or landscape release is admissible; this blocks operational use and does not reopen the identity decision.

The independent provider study was returned and was provider-truncated inside its blockers paragraph after 'WM-ACT-004 Service Definition'; only the visible verdict, counterexample/scenario, thirteen invariants and minimum profile shape are admitted as evidence, and no missing provider text is reconstructed. This frozen audit is complete. Crosswalks, relationship contracts and immutable pins remain pending.
